# Caps (CapAIGC) — Independent Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

> Independent FDE helping enterprises move AI from demo to production:
> enterprise AI deployment, Agent automation for small and medium businesses,
> and AI video production. Personal studio, one-week verifiable pilots first.

## Services

- [Enterprise AI deployment / FDE on-site service](https://caps-portfolio-v2.pages.dev/): workflow mapping, AI workflow and Agent build-out, on-site or remote delivery, weekly iteration.
- [Agent automation for SMBs](https://caps-portfolio-v2.pages.dev/): automating office and production workflows with AI agents, with handover documentation.
- [AI video production](https://caps-portfolio-v2.pages.dev/): AIGC short films, sales videos, animated series production, delivered in roughly 10-second shots.

## About

- Name: Caps, brand CapAIGC. Independent Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), personal studio.
- Focus: enterprise AI adoption, Agent automation, AIGC video production pipelines.
- Working model: one-week verifiable pilot first, then scale; all deliverables documented (workflows, prompts, acceptance criteria).
